entities.summary: Washington is a village in St. Landry Parish, Louisiana, United States. The population was 742 as of the 2020 census. It is part of the Opelousas–Eunice Micropolitan Statistical Area. Washington was the largest inland port between New Orleans and St. Louis for much of the 19th century. Washington is a town in North America, established around 1720. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
